final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.link_to_member AS m, mb.position AS p, COUNT(*) AS c FROM attendance a JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, mb.position), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1) SELECT s1.m, s1.p, s1.c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
